subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The singer’s performance __captivated__ the audience and left them mesmerised.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disillusioned**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Captivated **means enthralled, fascinated and deeply interested. (मुग्ध, गहरी दिलचस्पी)

 
 
• **Example**: *She was captivated by the mesmerizing beauty of the sunset.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Disillusioned **means disappointed or disenchanted. (निराश)
 
 
• **Example**: *After working at the company for a year, he became disillusioned with the corporate culture and decided to pursue a different career path.*
 
 
 
• The singer's performance left the audience mesmerized, so the opposite would be that they were left disappointed or disenchanted.
 
• So, the antonym of 'captivated' is 'disillusioned'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enthralled **means fascinated or captivated. (मोहित किया हुआ)
 
• **Horrified **means shocked or scared. (हैरान या डरा हुआ)
 
• **Resisted **means to oppose or fight against. (विरोध करना या लड़ना)
